    remaining = np.clip(remaining, 0, np.inf)
    utilization = 1 - remaining / bins
    # Use a combination of remaining capacity and utilization
    # with separate weights for different aspects
    # Higher remaining capacity -> lower priority
    # Higher utilization -> higher priority
    # Add a penalty for bins with very low remaining capacity
    penalty = np.where(remaining < 0.1 * bins, 1.0, 0.0)
    # Combine remaining capacity and utilization
    weight_remaining = np.clip(utilization, 0, 1)

    return priority
